aerospikeAction: 8.1.3 Unicode-safe string API, evaluated in AEL
notes: No index — this is a full scan with a string predicate, shown deliberately unindexed alongside the indexed scenarios. Worth seeding a few non-ASCII property names for this one: the String Ops PRD guarantees Unicode canonical equivalence on find/contains/replace, so precomposed and decomposed forms of the same name both match — a concrete, demoable claim for a global travel brand, not just another '==' filter.
